plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-16 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). The map is headed 'Computer Science map for 2026-2027' and the pathway is for catalog year 2026-2027. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. Card View and Table View agreed exactly on every fixed course, category, unit value and term total; Table View shows no prerequisites column, so the 'Prerequisites' flags below are Card View only. The inventoried program 'Computer Science' is listed in the mapper under that name; the program page states the student will be awarded an Associate in Science for Transfer degree and prints no separate total-units statement. This plan transcribes the only 2026-2027 pathway, 'Bakersfield College / Computer Science / Associate in Science for Transfer / 60-66.5 units / 4 terms / to CSU', in full; the page shows only the 4-term Bakersfield College segment. In 2025-2026 a detailed map existed in 6 terms at the same 60-66.5 unit total. The transcribed map prints term totals as 15-16.5 / 16-18 / 14-15 / 15-17. Ranged rows: Term 1 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5); Term 2 'Area 1B : Critical Thinking and Composition' (3-4) and 'Area 4 : Social and Behavioral Sciences' (3-4); Term 3 'Area 3B : Humanities' (3-4); Term 4 'Science Choice' (4-5) and 'Area 4 : Social and Behavioral Sciences' (3-4). Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged row is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. MATH C2211 and PHYS B4A are printed with the dual category label 'Major / Gen Ed'; they are named major courses and are recorded with category 'major'. The Term 4 'Science Choice' slot prints a closed two-course option set (CHEM B1A General Chemistry I; PHYS B4B Heat, Electricity, Magnetism); per the standing slot convention the options are named here and the slot itself is recorded unselected. MATH C2211, COMP B12, MATH C2221, COMP B13, PHYS B4A and COMP B14 carry a 'Prerequisites' flag in Card View; no other row shows a 'Prerequisites', 'Corequisites' or 'Dual Enrollment' flag, so no other prereqs are recorded. General-education and elective slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. No separate Certificate program named Computer Science exists in the mapper. The map page states verbatim: 'Program maps are for reference only. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan or visit CSU Transfer Planner for more options.'
